name: Tune a prompt with real tests, then keep versions
why: Scores a prompt against your test cases and keeps versions, the same loop as the prompt test set and tuning skill.

name: Prompt and skill tuner
why: Tests, fixes and re-tests a prompt in capped rounds until the checks pass, useful for quick tuning between health checks.

name: Support bot error reviewer
why: Turns redacted bot chats and approved help text into wrong-answer findings and retest cases, a good start for fixing an inventing chatbot.

name: Check an AI app improvement
why: Sets evaluation criteria for a proposed change to an AI app before it ships, matching the change-one-thing rule.

name: Harden an AI app against hijacked prompts and runaway bills
why: Adds injection defences, tests and spending caps to existing AI code, the core of the guardrails and launch review skill.

name: Agent injection evidence review assistant
why: Writes safe prompt injection test cases and keeps retest records, run only with the owner's written approval.

name: Review an agent before launch
why: Reviews tool access and risks in an agent's code and design before launch, for agents with tools or MCP servers.

name: Agent AI call cost tracker builder
why: Plans a wrapper that checks the budget before each AI call and records tokens and cost, the spending cap step of the feature build.

name: Agent spending cap builder
why: Builds budget reservation rules and hard stops in code, for features where a provider spend limit is not enough.

name: Turn an API into a safe, installable MCP server
why: Builds an MCP server with sign-in and a security check, following the MCP consent and token rules in the role knowledge.

name: Verify an MCP server release
why: Checks an MCP server's code and access risks before a release, a second pair of eyes on any server you connect an agent to.

name: AI pilot evaluation review assistant
why: Turns pilot results into an evidence brief and a go or stop result, useful when an owner asks whether the feature worked.
